result.title: Circe: Training-Free LLM Self-Evaluation via Component Interaction Consistency
result.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, evaluating the correctness of their responses is crucial for reliable use. However, such evaluation is challenging because reference answers are rarely available in practice. Existing reference-free methods mainly rely on output signals, which may assign high scores to incorrect responses and thus do not necessarily reflect correctness. This motivates exploring the model's internal computation for complementary correctness signals. Recent studies exploit internal states, but they mainly analyze hidden-state trajectories across layers, which record only the combined updates of attention and feed-forward networks (FFNs) and overlook how these components interact. We therefore propose Circe, a training-free self-evaluation method that assesses a response using both internal and external signals, without reference answers or repeated sampling. For internal signals, we first introduce component interaction consistency (CIC), which measures the directional alignment between attention updates in earlier layers and attention-induced FFN output changes in later layers. We further incorporate representation geometry (RG) to characterize normalized displacement and angular changes along layerwise hidden-state trajectories. For the external signal, we convert the mean negative log-likelihood of generated tokens into a bounded likelihood confidence (LC) score. Finally, we fuse CIC, RG, and LC into a unified correctness score. Experiments on five LLMs and six benchmarks across four domains show that our method distinguishes correct from incorrect responses more effectively than existing baselines, and generalizes to multilingual, multimodal, and open-world settings.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出免训练的自评方法 Circe，用「组件交互一致性」（早层注意力更新与后层注意力引起的 FFN 输出变化的方向对齐）、隐状态轨迹的表示几何特征和受限似然置信度融合成正确性评分，在五个 LLM、六个基准上优于现有无参考基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按层刻画隐状态轨迹几何与注意力—FFN 交互方向一致性，可能为判断 latent 状态是否真正承载任务相关信息、以及基于内部信号的停止决策提供可核查的度量线索，但研究对象是文本自评，需核查迁移到多模态视觉证据时的有效性。
